3.text:
PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2013-12-22 | 4 m MD | Alluvium | wellbore_instability | medium | 2.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Alluvium, tight hole on connections.
Remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.

2013-12-22 | 501 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | high | 16.1 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 71 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 16.1 hrs.

2013-12-27 | 2159 m MD | Barail | cementing_issue | medium | 3.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Barail.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2013-12-30 | 3054 m MD | Kopili | overpressure | medium | 6.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Kopili, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
Remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.

2013-12-30 | 3057 m MD | Kopili | kick | high | 7.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 107 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Kopili.
Remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.
